diagnosis: The MC–data B8 discrepancy (22.3% vs 2.3%) requires 11.1 g/cm² additional upstream material. Known missing components account for only 1.08 g/cm². The remaining deficit (10.0 g/cm²) likely comes from inter-stave dead material (PCBs, connectors, wrapping, light guides) not included in the simplified MC geometry.
recommendation: Update Geant4 geometry to include: (1) beam exit window, (2) T1/T2 trigger scintillators, (3) inter-stave dead material (estimated 0.5 g/cm² per pair). Re-run MV3 to verify chi2 improvement.
